planets.name: K2-72 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-72 with a 24.2-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-72 e was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-72. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DRESSING_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2016, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 24.158868, pl_radj 0.11508609, pl_bmassj 0.00696

quotes.title: K2-72e
quotes.card: K2-72e (also known by its EPIC designation EPIC 206209135.04), is a confirmed exoplanet, likely rocky, orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star K2-72, the outermost of four such planets discovered in the system by NASA's Kepler spacecraft on its "Second Light" mission.
quotes.introduction: It is located about 217.1 light-years (66.56 parsecs, or nearly 2.0538×1015 km) away from Earth in the constellation of Aquarius.
